question: What is the duration of the interval in a football match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15**__ __**minutes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Players are entitled to an interval at half-time, not exceeding **15 minutes**; a short drinks break (which should not exceed one minute) is permitted at the interval of half-time in extra time.
 
• Competition rules must state the duration of the **half-time interval **and it may be altered only with the referee’s permission.
 
• A match lasts for two equal halves of** 45 minutes **which may only be reduced if agreed between the referee and the two teams before the start of the match and is in accordance with competition rules.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football** in India has historically been among the top 3 most popular sport in terms of players participation and TV viewership, together with long time number one cricket and re-emerging kabaddi.
 
• India's current top domestic football league is **Indian Super League**, formed with eight teams to promote Indian football in the country and world. 
 
• Also contested is** Santosh Trophy**, a knock-out competition between states (provinces) and government institutions.
 
• The India national football team is the national football team of India and is governed by the **All India Football Federation**.
